newsitem.title: UK: Dollar inches down in Europe, dips under 114 yen.
newsitem.headline: Dollar inches down in Europe, dips under 114 yen.

text.p: 0925 GMT - Dollar/mark nudges down to lows but holds 1.73 amid optimism EU will strike stability pact deal at Amsterdam summit. Dollar/yen softens to probe under 114, nervous ahead of Japan, U.S. trade data this week and G7 summit June 20-22. Monetary source says G7 may not single out Japan trade surplus.
Japan MITI minister says surplus unlikely to grow drastically.
